topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The news comes like a cold wind, unsettling and harsh. My usual path, the one that leads to the place of familiarity and comfort, now holds an end I did not foresee. The memories of warmth and satisfaction, once so frequent, are now shadows that whisper of loss. Every step towards there feels heavier, the air thicker, as if the very earth and sky are mourning alongside. I clutch at routines, small defenses against the vast, changing world, but they slip through my fingers, grains of sand in an hourglass that marks a time I cannot halt. The quiet that follows the announcement is a void, echoing with the silence of a space once full of laughter and the clatter of dishes.
